home.headerLabel: Musicking-Aware Evaluation Learned from Structured Objectives of Music

hero.title: Musicking-Aware Evaluation Learned from Structured Objectives of Music
hero.lede: How do musicians and educators decide whether a piece of music is good? This is an anonymized multi-round study spanning three countries on the factors used when evaluating music, including AI music.

surveys.title: Survey rounds
surveys.sub: Each round opens once the previous one closes. You can leave and come back at any time.

flow.title: How the study works
flow.sub: The same panel of experts answers each round, so the group can move towards consensus.
flow.oneText: An eight-character tag is created for you. It is the only identifier we hold, so keep it somewhere safe.
flow.twoText: Answers save automatically as you go. Close the tab if you must; return later and resume with your tag.
flow.threeText: When a round closes, an anonymised summary of every expert's answers will be published on this page.
flow.fourText: In the next round your earlier answers are loaded for you, so you can keep them or change them.

docs.title: Study documents
docs.sub: Anonymised summary reports and study materials published by the study coordinator.
docs.empty: No documents have been published yet. Summary reports appear here after each round closes.

resume.title: Returning to the study?
resume.body: Enter the eight-character tag you generated earlier to pick up exactly where you left off.
resume.label: Your tag
resume.invalid: A tag is exactly 8 letters or numbers.
resume.none: We could not find an unfinished survey for that tag. It may already be complete — or check that the tag is exactly right.
resume.noneOpen: There are no surveys open right now.

footer.blurb: Project MAELStrOM studies how music is evaluated by real musicians, with a focus on AI music and its non-aural impact on music quality perception.
footer.privacy: Responses are anonymous and identified only by the participant's eight-character tag.
